environment.description: EC2 c5.xlarge running Amazon Linux 2023 with monolith compiled identically. pgBouncer 1.21 configured in prepared statement mode (server_prepared_statements=yes) with max_prepared_statements=100. Instance runs behind internal NLB with TLS termination. The binary is executed under a systemd service unit with MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes, RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_UNIX, and SystemCallFilter=~@debug @reboot @swap @raw-io @obsolete @privileged. The instance has a custom seccomp-bpf profile loaded via prctl(PR_SET_SECCOMP) at process start that restricts execve after initialization and blocks mprotect with PROT_EXEC flag. Additionally, the binary is compiled with the same -O2 but the AL2023 default gcc 11.4 toolchain enables -fstack-protector-strong and -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 by default in the system spec file (/usr/lib/rpm/redhat/macros), and the system has kernel.randomize_va_space=2.
